attrs.why_open: SURFACED BY R6.1, by moving DEF-FED-SEP-COST to the claim it was actually about. Once the tractability doubt left, this argument had no residual doubt at all — which was not true, only unstated. The specialisation to singleton separators is THIS PROJECT'S step: the citation supplies the algorithm given a join tree, and the identification of the block-cut tree as that join tree is an inference the citation does not make. Same species as DEF-FED-NERVE-INFERENCE against ARG-FED-PAIRWISE-CITATION. Nothing in this tree proves it and no witness would notice if it were wrong.
